notes.title: ValveTestApp496550 was a mistake, sorry
notes.notes:
Many have encountered an error in recent days, the game had been renamed to ValveTestApp496550.
This was a mistake made by Valve (Steam), I spoke with them, and finally they solved the problem, do not worry.
So, I did not want to troll anyone, in fact, I apologize in their name for this mistake.

Thank you all!
